# streams-log.txt: deterministic log lines the streams demo model mirrors.
# Format: <LEVEL>:<text>. Comments (#) and blank lines ignored.
TRACE:trace: plain default color
INFO:info: indexed palette line
WARN:warn: direct RGB line
ERROR:error: bold reversed alert
INFO:wide: 日本語 한국어 中文
INFO:icons: → ✓ ✗ ★ ⠋
TRACE:combining: é ä õ
WARN:spaced: padded   cells   here
INFO:box: ╔═╗║╚═╝ ┌─┐│└─┘
TRACE:tail: end of deterministic log
